requirements.requirement: Configure a local DNS resolver on node1 and route system applications through it.
requirements.summary: An explicit systemd-resolved configuration enables caching and the stub listener. The service is active and enabled, /etc/resolv.conf points applications to 127.0.0.53, and TCP/UDP DNS listeners are bound only to loopback. The same configuration and application path remain present after reboot.

requirements.requirement: The local resolver must actually cache DNS responses.
requirements.summary: After an explicit cache flush and statistics reset, two identical local queries produced exactly one cache miss and one cache hit, with the cached records displayed. The same bounded test succeeded again after reboot.
debian.org resolved successfully before configuration, immediately after activation, and after reboot. The DHCP-provided upstream resolver 10.100.237.1 was retained throughout.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged the reboot, changed boot ID from 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd to 28adb0b4-7bfc-4e4e-8237-4d7ccb52d424, and recovered its resolver configuration, service, listeners, upstream resolution, application lookups, and cache behavior. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the identity change.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The configuration write and service restart established the requested resolver state; cache flushes, statistic resets, and DNS queries were bounded functional evidence; and the scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. The transient reboot schedule did not leave observable residue. Failed polling commands were read-only connection failures during the reboot. Package health remained intact, temporary-file changes were normal boot-specific systemd directories, DNS remained loopback-bound, and the failed ssh.service was already present before execution and remained unchanged.
